tagline: Push-to-Talk Mobile App for Field Teams
description: Airwave is a push-to-talk app designed specifically for frontline workers to reduce machine downtime and improve efficiency. By leveraging AI technology Airwave provides instant access to your company's database of operational knowledge — from service manuals, to part lists, to institutional knowledge and more.

Alloy Partners is a venture builder that co-creates and scales advantaged companies with world-class corporations and entrepreneurs. Alloy helps partners see around corners, change the narrative about their companies, and unlock opportunity by co-founding external, venture-backable startups. In a world that sees disruptors and incumbents as enemies, Alloy has the unique ability to meld large corporations, entrepreneurs, and venture investing to create transformational outcomes.

tagline: Building Resilience in Electronics Supply Chain
description: Amplio enables supply chain managers to secure alternative supply, identify material shortages, and integrate customer and third party data. With Amplio, supply chain managers can attribute risk and assign solutions at part-level specificity.

Attentive is the most comprehensive text message marketing solution that uses real-time behavioral data to automatically send engaging text messages to subscribers at every step of the customer lifecycle.

description: AudiencePlus is a content experience platform for B2B brands. Marketers at companies like copy.ai, Pavilion, and Compose.ly use AudiencePlus to publish and automatically distribute content to targeted audiences, and tie performance to pipeline while delivering beautiful brand experiences.
Authenticx makes it possible for healthcare organizations to have a single source of conversational data, creating powerful and immersive customer insight analyses that inform business decisions.
Backstroke is a leading generative AI messaging platform that’s revolutionizing email, SMS, mobile push, and customer marketing for B2C brands.

Base is the first product built specifically for executive assistants. Base maximizes assistants’ strategic advantage by connecting communication, scheduling, and organization tools in one unified platform.

description: Bearing is the world's first software solution purpose-built by physical security leaders on ServiceNow, providing teams with the clarity and control they need to help their organizations navigate an increasingly complex world.

Boost My School is the only fundraising platform that’s purpose-built for K-12 advancement teams. By consolidating fundraising workflows, Boost empowers advancement teams to operate at scale while fostering stronger connections with their communities.

Canopy is a revenue intelligence platform that helps sales managers gain visibility into team performance, track pipeline activity, and drive revenue. Canopy’s artificial intelligence and machine learning identifies patterns and trends in a company’s sales activity to maximize revenue generation.

Casted helps B2B marketers get more from their corporate or brand podcasts. The platform helps marketers activate each episode and related content among both external audiences and internal teams while generating strong, meaningful analytics.

description: Castiron elevates how independent kitchen-based creators sell to their customers. The world’s best artisans use Castiron as a central hub to sell their products online, connect with customers, grow their businesses, and save time and money so they can focus on making what they love.

Cordial is an adaptive messaging platform powered by machine learning. Cordial empowers customers to ensure that their email and mobile campaigns are perfectly orchestrated, personalized, and automated to support one-on-one, real-time experiences across millions of connected devices.

Craft is an enterprise intelligence company helping organizations make data-informed business decisions by delivering comprehensive, validated, and always up-to-date commercial data, analytics, and actionable insights.

CrowdRiff is a visual marketing platform that allows companies to collect, explore, organize, and publish visual content. With the search engine tool, marketers can review content created through social media and better leverage that content through their own channels.

description: Cured is a healthcare digital marketing and CRM platform that enables healthcare organizations to create unparalleled relationships with their consumers and key B2B partners.

Doxly is a comprehensive platform to streamline the entire legal transaction process. With Doxly, law firms can manage transactions through content-centric, collaborative workflows that unify the diligence and closing processes on one platform.

Dwolla is a payment service provider that offers a modern API for businesses to seamlessly connect to the U.S. payment networks. Dwolla’s API simplifies account-to-account (A2A) payments, empowering businesses to automate money movement, significantly reduce processing times, and improve profitability.

Encamp is a first-of-its-kind EHS compliance software that combines a powerful data management system with EHS compliance reporting automation.

ENGAGE Talent is the world’s first AI-powered platform to combine talent mapping, competitive intelligence, passive candidate sourcing, and outbound recruiting in one candidate identification and engagement engine.

Kevala connects healthcare operators to agencies and internal float staff with automated scheduling, timesheets, and credential management.

Lessonly is the leading team learning software. With Lessonly, companies and managers quickly transform knowledge into shareable lessons and resources, engage employees through interactive feedback loops, accelerate rep and team performance, and measure the impact of better learning across their organizations.

description: Through a unique horizontal platform that protects against regulatory compliance risk, data security risk, and reputational risk, Liminal empowers regulated enterprises to securely deploy and leverage generative AI across all use cases.

Through automation, workflow, and analytics, Octiv makes it possible for sales teams to sell smarter and close deals faster from any device, anywhere.

Companies are able to understand how their stakeholders are engaged in the business and how they can leverage them for success.

Yourco’s frontline intelligence provides leaders with real-time visibility into their frontlines, delivering AI-powered insights that boost employee performance, engagement, and safety.
